responsibility: Defines the MinGW/MS-specific format-checking tables used by GCC’s C-family -Wformat diagnostics on x86 Windows targets. It describes the accepted length modifiers, flags, conversion characters, and target override mappings for ms_printf, ms_scanf, and ms_strftime attributes, and optionally adjusts their pedantic classification, so the frontend can validate Microsoft-style format strings and argument types distinctly from the default GNU or ISO format dialects.
